## Ctx.notifySendError() method

Invoke the `onSendError` hook best-effort (Q9 option b).

**Signature:**

```typescript
notifySendError(err: unknown, kind: `fallback-text` | `retryable`, chatId?: number): void;
```

## Remarks

Builds `{page, kind, chatId}` and calls the hook inside a nested try/catch — a throwing hook is swallowed and never breaks the send flow. Silent when no hook is configured. Validation throws are programmer errors and never reach this helper (hook-free by design).
